## Appearance

Margaret was a shore girl who possessed a sweet, small white face paired with pale, brown hair. Her hands featured long, slender fingers that were noted for their brown complexion.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017)_

## History

Margaret was a Junior girl at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). During the previous winter, she wrote a story that was published in the [Canadian Woman](../codex/factions.md#canadian-woman).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P46](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0046)_
